title: Project Manager
description:
The EPA IT and Telecommunications Support Program provides comprehensive IT and telecommunications services to the EPA's National Vehicle and Fuel Emissions Laboratory (NVFEL). The Program aims to support the laboratory's mission of conducting emissions testing and ensuring compliance with federal emissions and fuel economy standards. The Program covers various services, including desktop management, data center management, enterprise connectivity, IT security, business support, and application services. To acquire the advantage, Zolon seeks a Project Manager to support this Program.

Job Description:
Responsible for ensuring the project team completes the project within the schedule and budget.
Provide project management support for new and existing IT development projects. Provides the overall management of the project direction as related to functionality, schedule, and budget.
Ensures adherence to project management and EPA-specific software development life cycle and best practices; Manages the team's performance on project tasks.
Secures acceptance and approval of deliverables from the project sponsor.
Responsible for status reporting, risk management, and escalation of issues that cannot be resolved by the project team; Liaises with all current and future stakeholders.
Give periodic project, program, and operational status updates as required by the government within an agreed-upon frequency and schedule. These are typically weekly or monthly task order status reports and weekly Agile/Scrum development meetings.
Manage and oversee daily, weekly, and monthly workloads and schedules for active tasks with regard to schedule, budget, priority, risk, and quality to ensure quality response to government task order requests.

Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
Experience managing projects in an Agile Scrum environment, conducting Agile ceremonies.
5+ years of Project Management experience.
Having one or more of the following certifications is a plus:
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification
Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) certification
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Must be a technical expert in Cybersecurity, datacenter management, Helpdesk support, enterprise connectivity, audio/video and voice services, or application services.
Experience working for the EPA is a plus.
Location: Onsite Ann Arbor, MI
Clearance: Ability to obtain a Public trust.

title: Senior PL/SQL Developer / Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
Job Title: Senior PL/SQL Developer / Database Administrator (DBA)
Overview
The Senior PL/SQL Developer / Database Administrator (DBA) is a highly skilled, independent performer responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining complex Oracle database systems supporting enterprise and mission-critical applications.
This role blends advanced PL/SQL development with database administration expertise, ensuring performance, scalability, security, and reliability — particularly within federal or public-sector environments.
The ideal candidate is a self-motivated professional capable of working independently with minimal supervision, while also collaborating effectively across technical and business teams.
Key Responsibilities
PL/SQL Development
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers to support business logic and application requirements.
  • Independently analyze, design, and implement database solutions aligned with project goals.
  • Optimize and tune SQL queries for maximum performance and efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and data pipelines.
  • Implement and manage data validation, integrity, and quality controls.
  • Participate in code reviews and enforce database development best practices.
Database Administration
  • Install, configure, and maintain Oracle database environments (11g, 12c, 19c or higher).
  • Independently perform database backup, recovery, cloning, and disaster recovery operations using RMAN or Data Pump.
  • Monitor and tune database performance using AWR, ASH, and SQL tuning tools.
  • Manage user access, roles, and security in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Plan and perform database patching, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Automate administrative tasks using scripts (Shell, Python, or PL/SQL).
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards (FISMA, HIPAA, NIST 800-53).
Collaboration & Leadership
  • Serve as a technical lead and independent contributor, capable of driving initiatives from concept to completion.
  • Collaborate with application teams, system administrators, and project managers to ensure seamless database integration.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to enhance system scalability and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for database structures, configurations, and processes.
Qualifications
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (Master's preferred).
Experience:
  • 7+ years of experience as a PL/SQL Developer and Oracle DBA.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex database design, development, and performance tuning projects.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, high-availability databases in mission-critical environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based database services (Oracle Cloud, AWS RDS, Azure SQL) is a plus.
Technical Skills:
  • Expertise in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and database architecture.
  • Strong experience with performance tuning tools (AWR, ADDM, OEM, SQL*Plus).
  • Proficient in Unix/Linux shell scripting.
  • Skilled in data modeling, indexing, and normalization.
  • Experience with backup/recovery tools (RMAN, Data Pump).
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git, SVN).
Soft Skills:
  • Proven ability to operate as an independent performer with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on reliability, precision, and performance.
Preferred Certifications and Clearances
  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) – Database Administrator or Developer.
  • AWS Certified Database – Specialty (optional).
  • Active Public Trust clearance (or ability to obtain) highly desirable.

title: AWS Systems Administrator
description:
The AWS Systems Administrator is responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining secure, automated, and scalable systems within the AWS Cloud environment. This role partners with cross-functional teams to ensure governance, security compliance, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of infrastructure solutions supporting mission-critical applications.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated deployments of systems on AWS Cloud.
Configure, deploy, and manage AWS infrastructure leveraging core services such as EC2, S3, VPC, Security Groups, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (SSM), Inspector, and IAM.
Manage AWS security, compliance, performance, resource utilization, cost optimization, and budgeting.
Automate backups, disaster recovery, and incident response processes.
Collaborate with Security, Architecture, and Governance teams to ensure compliance with organizational and federal standards.
Implement automated monitoring and alerting systems; troubleshoot production issues.
Apply architecture design patterns and enforce best practices in coding and infrastructure implementation.
Develop and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines; build, test, and release infrastructure and applications.
Research and integrate emerging technologies to support development, modernization, and migration initiatives to AWS.

Required Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience/combined education).
Experience:
5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud computing concepts.
5+ years of hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Kubernetes, ELK Stack, or Splunk.
Hands-on experience with Ansible and AWS CloudFormation.
Experience implementing infrastructure capacity monitoring and automated scaling solutions.
10+ years of experience designing and deploying containerized solutions using Docker with Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Experience in configuring and managing the Qualys vulnerability management tool.
Strong understanding of networking protocols, including HTTP, DNS, and TCP/IP.
Proficiency with Git for version control.
Strong programming skills in one or more mainstream languages (e.g., Python, Java).
Practical experience with relational databases such as Oracle or other RDBMS platforms.

Preferred Certifications:
HashiCorp Terraform Associate Certification (preferred).
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate (preferred).

Clearance: Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance
Location: Remote

title: SharePoint Administrator/Developer

Cyber Security and Information Technology (IT) Training

Active DoD Secret or obtain Secret clearance before performing work on this task order.
